description: Search Google Maps by category/keyword + location, extract business details, and enrich with emails + social links from each business website.

category.description: Predefined Google Maps business category (e.g., bakery, dentist, plumber). Used when keyword is not provided.
category.title: Category

country.description: Target country for global searches. When set to a non-US country, the state filter is ignored.
country.title: Country (global search)

extractEmails.description: If on, crawls each business website to extract email addresses and social media links.
extractEmails.title: Extract Emails & Social Links

keyword.description: Custom keyword search. If provided, takes priority over category (e.g., 'boutique coffee', 'pet grooming').
keyword.title: Keyword (overrides category)

language.description: Language for Google Maps interface and results.
language.title: Language

max_results.description: Maximum number of business leads to return (1–100,000). Results are pushed progressively.
max_results.title: Max Results

minRating.description: Only include businesses with a rating at or above this value (1.0–5.0). Leave empty to include all.
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Apify Proxy AUTO is recommended.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

searchQueries.description: Optional array of free-text Google Maps queries. If provided, overrides the category/keyword+state/country combination.
searchQueries.title: Advanced: Raw Search Queries

state.description: US state filter (2-letter code) or 'All' for nationwide. Only used when country is US or not set.
state.title: US State

title: Google Maps Business Leads Scraper Input
